versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
Handles the free options headline preview and the one-week free earnings calendar: the diagram carries a preview label and shows the next report as unknown, never as unscheduled.
Copy: options data refreshes the evening of the session; follow-ups compare the next session's open interest.
Adds a scoped handoff to the expected-move skill for comparing a modeled breakeven against the implied range and past reactions; removes the npx execution path and declares permissions.
Corrects the breakeven in the worked example, and describes the price as delayed rather than live.
optional context calls now degrade gracefully instead of exiting; clearer free-tier preview badge; volatility wording fix

Initial release: interactive profit-and-loss-at-expiry diagrams for nine strategies, pre-loaded with live per-ticker data (last price, 30/60/90d implied volatility, 25-delta skew, IV rank, next earnings date). Premiums modeled with Black-Scholes from end-of-day IV; artifact renders offline.
